## Overview

Add native text inference for [SenseNova-Loop-9B-Preview](https://huggingface.co/sensenova/SenseNova-Loop-9B-Preview), reusing Qwen3.5 layers with fixed-count loop execution and mHC routing.

No other open PR was found in searches for `sensenova` and `"SenseNova Loop"`.

## Claims

- Native checkpoint loading, tensor parallelism and decode CUDA Graphs.
- Shared weights with separate attention/recurrent state for each loop visit.
- Checkpoint SSM dtype defaults are respected; explicit overrides take precedence.

## Validation

H100 80GB, BF16, PyTorch 2.14.0+cu130, Transformers 5.21.1; `VLLM_GPU_SYNC_CHECK=error` enabled.

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Local config, generation, kernel, registry and initialization checks | 90 passed at `d657efd337` |
| Public checkpoint vs HF, 2 prompts × 16 tokens | Passed the existing top-5 check |
| GSM8K, first 256 questions, 5-shot, TP=2, greedy chat, thinking off, max 512 output tokens | 238/256 (92.97%), no invalid answers; prior revision: 239/256 |
| 2,891-token input, five prefill chunks, 256-token decode, TP=1/2 | Reciprocal top-5 membership on all 256 teacher-forced steps; free-running outputs differ |
| Applicable pre-commit hooks | Passed |

Runtime code is unchanged since that 90-case run. Standalone test and benchmark files are excluded from the final diff; CI retains registry and dummy-initialization coverage. Upstream CI has not run past the contributor eligibility check.

<details>
<summary>Test commands and regression evidence</summary>

Run at `d657efd337`:

```bash
.venv/bin/python -m pytest \
  tests/models/test_sensenova_loop.py \
  tests/models/language/generation/test_sensenova_loop.py \
  tests/kernels/mhc/test_sensenova_loop_mhc.py \
  tests/models/test_registry.py \
  tests/models/test_initialization.py \
  -k 'sensenova or SenseNovaLoop' -v
# 90 passed, 870 deselected in 371.39 s
```

The four regression cases were also run against `426b060cc381` with the test file applied:

```bash
.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/models/language/generation/test_sensenova_loop.py \
  -k 'ssm_cache_dtype or rejects_sharded_state' -v
# Before: 3 failed, 1 passed. After: all four passed.
```

Before the fix, auto allocated `(bfloat16, bfloat16)` state instead of `(bfloat16, float32)`. Actual save/reload also reproduced `ValueError: Missing keys ('model.layers.3.self_attn.qkv_proj.weight', ...) in loaded state!`.

GSM8K used `tests.evals.gsm8k.gsm8k_eval.evaluate_gsm8k_offline` with the table's parameters, context 4096, max 8 sequences, prefill budget 2048 and 2 GiB cache. Checkpoint revision: `27abea779b1e6634b136805b6519371739d551f7`. Native extensions were from upstream build `a17e79abde45715e79a00deb99ad34be49162231`.

```bash
.venv/bin/python -m pre_commit run --from-ref 59d58fd261 --to-ref HEAD
```

</details>

## Details

Loop parameters are tied after weight processing, with separate cache slots per visit. Loading therefore uses more weight memory than steady-state inference. SSM dtype handling reuses Qwen3.5's conditional-generation config hook.

`sharded_state` and `runai_streamer_sharded` are rejected before workers start: exports deduplicate shared weights before a fresh model has restored their aliases. Support is limited to unquantized text inference; further limits and launch examples are in the [model documentation](https://github.com/sufubao/vllm/blob/pr/sensenova-loop/docs/models/sensenova_loop.md).

@@ -0,0 +1,107 @@
+# SenseNova Loop with mHC
+
+The `SenseNovaLoopForConditionalGeneration` implementation serves text from
+the public [SenseNova-Loop-9B-Preview](https://huggingface.co/sensenova/SenseNova-Loop-9B-Preview)
+checkpoint and compatible `sensenova_loop` checkpoints. It uses a fixed
+`loop_settings.eval_count`, shares repeated layer parameters, and keeps separate
+attention and recurrent caches for every execution of a layer. Optional mHC
+routers retain FP32 weights and use log-space Sinkhorn normalization.
+
+The implementation requires unquantized weights. On NVIDIA GPUs, it defaults to
+full decode CUDA Graphs without Torch compilation; prefill executes eagerly.
+Explicit compilation settings and `--enforce-eager` take precedence.
+It supports tensor parallelism, but not pipeline parallelism, vision, audio,
+LoRA, speculative decoding, learned loop gates, or layer scaling. CPU weight
+offloading is unsupported with shared loop weights: nonzero `--cpu-offload-gb`
+or `--offload-group-size` is rejected before workers start.
+The `sharded_state` and `runai_streamer_sharded` load formats are also rejected
+before workers start. Sharded-state exports deduplicate shared parameters, but
+this model restores their aliases only after weight processing. Load the original
+checkpoint with `auto` or `safetensors` instead of a `save_sharded_state` export.
+
+SSM cache precision follows the checkpoint's `mamba_ssm_dtype` when
+`--mamba-ssm-cache-dtype` is `auto`. The public checkpoint uses FP32 SSM state
+even with BF16 weights and convolution state. An explicit
+`--mamba-ssm-cache-dtype` setting takes precedence.
+
+```bash
+vllm serve sensenova/SenseNova-Loop-9B-Preview \
+  --served-model-name sensenova_loop \
+  --tensor-parallel-size 2 \
+  --dtype bfloat16 \
+  --compilation-config '{"mode":0,"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_DECODE_ONLY","cudagraph_capture_sizes":[1,2,4,8]}' \
+  --max-model-len 4096 \
+  --max-num-seqs 8 \
+  --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8001
+```
+
+The public checkpoint loads natively without `--trust-remote-code` or
+architecture overrides. Its [reference implementation](https://huggingface.co/sensenova/SenseNova-Loop-9B-Preview/blob/main/modeling_sensenova_loop.py)
+and weights are published under Apache 2.0. The checkpoint includes vision and
+MTP weights; this implementation loads the text backbone and mHC routers and
+ignores those additional weights. Image inputs and MTP remain unsupported.
+
+Native loading expects the following top-level fields in `config.json`, alongside
+the checkpoint's text, loop and mHC settings:
+
+```json
+{
+  "model_type": "sensenova_loop",
+  "architectures": ["SenseNovaLoopForConditionalGeneration"]
+}
+```
+
+To override the loop count or mHC settings at startup, pass their complete
+objects through `--hf-overrides`. The execution plan and mHC boundary checks
+are recomputed after overrides; physical checkpoint layers remain unchanged.
+Setting `loop_settings` to `null` runs each physical layer once and retains
+the mHC settings. The mHC `pre_scale` must be a positive finite number.
+
+```bash
+--hf-overrides '{"loop_settings":{"start":4,"end":28,"eval_count":3}}'
+```
+
+## Execution plan and parameter sharing
+
+The checkpoint describes physical layers. vLLM needs one logical layer for each
+execution of a physical layer, including repetitions, so it can allocate separate
+attention and recurrent cache state. `SenseNovaLoopConfig` expands the physical
+layer indices and attention types before model initialization. It retains the
+physical metadata and rebuilds the plan after `--hf-overrides`; applying an
+override therefore does not expand an already expanded plan.
+
+Each logical layer has its own module and cache identity. A model post-load hook
+ties repeated layers' parameters after loading and weight processing, including
+dummy initialization. Reusing the entire decoder module would also reuse its
+cache identity, which would mix states from different loop iterations. Parameter
+sharing reduces steady-state weight memory, but does not reduce the number of
+attention or recurrent cache entries. At load time, repeated layers temporarily
+allocate separate weights before tying parameters, so allow additional memory
+during initialization. Vision weights are ignored for text inference.
+
+The native implementation reuses Qwen3.5 attention, recurrent-state helpers,
+normalization, MLP and weight-loading components. It supplies the loop execution
+plan and mHC residual-stream operations while keeping the scheduler and model
+runner unchanged. The custom config adapts checkpoint metadata to vLLM's logical
+layer layout; it is not a replacement for the checkpoint's reference model.
+The HF reference maps each physical-layer visit to a separate `DynamicCache`
+slot. The native model expresses these execution slots through vLLM's hybrid
+model interfaces, so both attention and recurrent state follow the loop plan.
+
+## mHC numerical behavior
+
+BF16 CUDA inference reuses vLLM's
+`hc_collapse_triton` mHC stream reduction. Coefficients are rounded to BF16
+before reduction, as in the checkpoint implementation. A fused Triton kernel
+performs log-space Sinkhorn normalization. Residual merging preserves the
+checkpoint's matrix orientation and BF16 intermediate rounding; the generic
+`MHCPreOp` and `MHCPostOp` use different normalization and rounding conventions.
+
+CUDA routing uses a fused FP32 RMS normalization and, for up to 32 tokens, a
+split-K FP32 projection. Larger batches retain the cuBLAS projection. Two-stream
+BF16 residual merging is fused into one kernel; wider streams retain the
+original matrix multiplication to preserve its accumulation order. These paths
+support CUDA Graph replay without reducing router precision.
+
+Use `--enforce-eager` instead of the compilation configuration for an eager
+baseline. Add `--cudagraph-metrics` to inspect actual graph dispatch statistics.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""SenseNova Loop routing with FP32 logits and BF16 stream coefficients."""
+
+import torch
+from torch import Tensor
+
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, tldevice, triton
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _mhc_rmsnorm_kernel(
+    x,
+    out,
+    stride_t: tl.constexpr,
+    stride_s: tl.constexpr,
+    stride_h: tl.constexpr,
+    hidden: tl.constexpr,
+    streams: tl.constexpr,
+    block: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    token = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    offsets = tl.arange(0, block)
+    values = tl.load(
+        x
+        + token * stride_t
+        + offsets // hidden * stride_s
+        + offsets % hidden * stride_h,
+        offsets < hidden * streams,
+        0,
+    ).to(tl.float32)
+    inv = tl.rsqrt(tl.sum(values * values, 0) / (hidden * streams) + 1e-6)
+    tl.store(
+        out + token * hidden * streams + offsets,
+        values * inv,
+        offsets < hidden * streams,
+    )
+
+
+def mhc_rmsnorm_triton(x: Tensor) -> Tensor:
+    """Normalize residual streams into a contiguous FP32 routing input."""
+    tokens, streams, hidden = x.shape
+    out = torch.empty((tokens, streams * hidden), device=x.device, dtype=torch.float32)
+    if tokens:
+        block = triton.next_power_of_2(streams * hidden)
+        _mhc_rmsnorm_kernel[(tokens,)](
+            x,
+            out,
+            *x.stride(),
+            hidden,
+            streams,
+            block,
+            num_warps=4 if block <= 4096 else 8,
+            enable_fp_fusion=False,
+        )
+    return out
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _mhc_project_partial_kernel(
+    x,
+    weight,
+    partial,
+    width: tl.constexpr,
+    outputs: tl.constexpr,
+    splits: tl.constexpr,
+    block: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    row = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    split = tl.program_id(1)
+    token = row // outputs
+    output = row % outputs
+    offsets = split * block + tl.arange(0, block)
+    a = tl.load(x + token * width + offsets, offsets < width, 0)
+    b = tl.load(weight + output * width + offsets, offsets < width, 0)
+    value = tl.sum(a * b, 0)
+    tl.store(partial + row * splits + split, value)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _mhc_project_reduce_kernel(
+    partial,
+    bias,
+    out,
+    outputs: tl.constexpr,
+    splits: tl.constexpr,
+    block: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    row = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    offsets = tl.arange(0, block)
+    values = tl.load(partial + row * splits + offsets, offsets < splits, 0)
+    value = tl.sum(values, 0) + tl.load(bias + row % outputs)
+    tl.store(out + row, value)
+
+
+def mhc_project_triton(x: Tensor, weight: Tensor, bias: Tensor) -> Tensor:
+    """Split-K FP32 projection for small decode routing matrices."""
+    tokens, width = x.shape
+    outputs = weight.shape[0]
+    block = 2048 if tokens >= 32 else 1024
+    splits = triton.cdiv(width, block)
+    partial = torch.empty((tokens * outputs, splits), device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
+    out = torch.empty((tokens, outputs), device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
+    if tokens:
+        _mhc_project_partial_kernel[(tokens * outputs, splits)](
+            x,
+            weight,
+            partial,
+            width,
+            outputs,
+            splits,
+            block,
+            num_warps=4,
+            enable_fp_fusion=False,
+        )
+        _mhc_project_reduce_kernel[(tokens * outputs,)](
+            partial,
+            bias,
+            out,
+            outputs,
+            splits,
+            triton.next_power_of_2(splits),
+            num_warps=1,
+            enable_fp_fusion=False,
+        )
+    return out
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _mhc_merge_kernel(
+    residual,
+    branch,
+    post,
+    mix,
+    out,
+    residual_stride_t: tl.constexpr,
+    residual_stride_s: tl.constexpr,
+    residual_stride_h: tl.constexpr,
+    branch_stride_t: tl.constexpr,
+    branch_stride_h: tl.constexpr,
+    post_stride_t: tl.constexpr,
+    post_stride_s: tl.constexpr,
+    mix_stride_t: tl.constexpr,
+    mix_stride_row: tl.constexpr,
+    mix_stride_col: tl.constexpr,
+    hidden: tl.constexpr,
+    streams: tl.constexpr,
+    block: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    token = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    offsets = tl.program_id(1) * block + tl.arange(0, block)
+    x = tl.load(
+        branch + token * branch_stride_t + offsets * branch_stride_h,
+        offsets < hidden,
+        0,
+    ).to(tl.float32)
+    for row in tl.static_range(streams):
+        mixed = tl.full((block,), 0, tl.float32)
+        for col in tl.static_range(streams):
+            coefficient = tl.load(
+                mix + token * mix_stride_t + row * mix_stride_row + col * mix_stride_col
+            )
+            coefficient = coefficient.to(tl.bfloat16).to(tl.float32)
+            r = tl.load(
+                residual
+                + token * residual_stride_t
+                + col * residual_stride_s
+                + offsets * residual_stride_h,
+                offsets < hidden,
+                0,
+            ).to(tl.float32)
+            mixed = tl.fma(coefficient, r, mixed)
+        p = (
+            tl.load(post + token * post_stride_t + row * post_stride_s)
+            .to(tl.bfloat16)
+            .to(tl.float32)
+        )
+        update = (p * x).to(tl.bfloat16).to(tl.float32)
+        value = mixed.to(tl.bfloat16).to(tl.float32) + update
+        tl.store(
+            out + (token * streams + row) * hidden + offsets, value, offsets < hidden
+        )
+
+
+def mhc_merge_triton(
+    residual: Tensor, branch: Tensor, post: Tensor, mix: Tensor
+) -> Tensor:
+    """Merge output-to-input mixing matrices with BF16 intermediate rounding."""
+    tokens, streams, hidden = residual.shape
+    if streams != 2:
+        # Preserve cuBLAS accumulation order for wider residual streams.
+        return mix.to(residual.dtype) @ residual + (
+            post.to(branch.dtype).unsqueeze(-1) * branch.unsqueeze(-2)
+        )
+    out = torch.empty(residual.shape, device=residual.device, dtype=residual.dtype)
+    mix_strides = (0, *mix.stride()) if mix.ndim == 2 else mix.stride()
+    if tokens:
+        _mhc_merge_kernel[(tokens, triton.cdiv(hidden, 512))](
+            residual,
+            branch,
+            post,
+            mix,
+            out,
+            *residual.stride(),
+            *branch.stride(),
+            *post.stride(),
+            *mix_strides,
+            hidden,
+            streams,
+            512,
+            num_warps=4,
+            enable_fp_fusion=False,
+        )
+    return out
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _mhc_log_sinkhorn_kernel(
+    logits,
+    output,
+    stride_t: tl.constexpr,
+    streams: tl.constexpr,
+    iterations: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    token = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    row = tl.arange(0, streams)
+    col = tl.arange(0, streams)
+    offsets = row[:, None] * streams + col[None, :]
+    mix = tl.load(logits + token * stride_t + offsets)
+    for _ in range(iterations):
+        maximum = tl.max(mix, 1)
+        normalizer = maximum + tldevice.log(
+            tl.sum(tldevice.exp(mix - maximum[:, None]), 1)
+        )
+        mix = mix - normalizer[:, None]
+        maximum = tl.max(mix, 0)
+        normalizer = maximum + tldevice.log(
+            tl.sum(tldevice.exp(mix - maximum[None, :]), 0)
+        )
+        mix = mix - normalizer[None, :]
+    tl.store(output + token * streams * streams + offsets, tldevice.exp(mix))
+
+
+def mhc_log_sinkhorn_triton(logits: Tensor, iterations: int) -> Tensor:
+    """Normalize FP32 mHC logits by alternating log-space row/column sums."""
+    assert logits.ndim == 3 and logits.dtype == torch.float32
+    tokens, streams, columns = logits.shape
+    assert streams in (2, 4) and columns == streams
+    assert logits.stride(-1) == 1 and logits.stride(-2) == streams
+    assert iterations > 0
+    output = torch.empty(logits.shape, device=logits.device, dtype=logits.dtype)
+    if tokens:
+        _mhc_log_sinkhorn_kernel[(tokens,)](
+            logits,
+            output,
+            logits.stride(0),
+            streams,
+            iterations,
+            num_warps=1,
+            enable_fp_fusion=False,
+        )
+    return output

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

+
+from typing import Any
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+from torch import nn
+
+
+class MHCRouter(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, hidden_size: int, settings: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.streams = settings["streams"]
+        self.iterations = settings["iterations"]
+        self.fixed_identity = settings["fixed_identity"]
+        self.pre_scale = settings.get("pre_scale", 1.0)
+        num_outputs = 2 * self.streams
+        if not self.fixed_identity:
+            num_outputs += self.streams**2
+        self.weight = nn.Parameter(
+            torch.empty(num_outputs, self.streams * hidden_size, dtype=torch.float32),
+            requires_grad=False,
+        )
+        self.bias = nn.Parameter(
+            torch.empty(num_outputs, dtype=torch.float32), requires_grad=False
+        )
+
+    def forward(
+        self, residual: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        if residual.is_cuda:
+            from vllm.model_executor.kernels.mhc import sensenova_loop as mhc_kernels
+            from vllm.model_executor.kernels.mhc.triton import hc_collapse_triton
+
+            normalized = mhc_kernels.mhc_rmsnorm_triton(residual)
+        else:
+            flat = residual.flatten(-2).float()
+            normalized = flat * torch.rsqrt(flat.square().mean(-1, keepdim=True) + 1e-6)
+
+        if residual.is_cuda and residual.shape[0] <= 32:
+            logits = mhc_kernels.mhc_project_triton(normalized, self.weight, self.bias)
+        else:
+            logits = F.linear(normalized, self.weight, self.bias)
+
+        streams = self.streams
+        pre = logits[..., :streams].sigmoid()
+        post = 2 * logits[..., streams : 2 * streams].sigmoid()
+        if self.fixed_identity:
+            mix = torch.eye(streams, device=residual.device, dtype=torch.float32)
+        else:
+            mix = logits[..., 2 * streams :].unflatten(-1, (streams, streams))
+            if residual.is_cuda:
+                mix = mhc_kernels.mhc_log_sinkhorn_triton(mix, self.iterations)
+            else:
+                for _ in range(self.iterations):
+                    mix = mix - mix.logsumexp(-1, keepdim=True)
+                    mix = mix - mix.logsumexp(-2, keepdim=True)
+                mix = mix.exp()
+        if residual.is_cuda and residual.dtype == torch.bfloat16:
+            # The checkpoint rounds coefficients before stream reduction.
+            branch = hc_collapse_triton(residual, pre.to(residual.dtype).float())
+        else:
+            branch = (pre.to(residual.dtype).unsqueeze(-2) @ residual).squeeze(-2)
+        return branch * self.pre_scale, post, mix
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def merge(
+        residual: torch.Tensor,
+        branch: torch.Tensor,
+        post: torch.Tensor,
+        mix: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if residual.is_cuda and residual.dtype == torch.bfloat16:
+            from vllm.model_executor.kernels.mhc.sensenova_loop import mhc_merge_triton
+
+            return mhc_merge_triton(residual, branch, post, mix)
+        mixed = mix.to(residual.dtype) @ residual
+        update = post.to(branch.dtype).unsqueeze(-1) * branch.unsqueeze(-2)
+        return mixed + update

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Text inference for fixed-count SenseNova Loop checkpoints with optional mHC."""
+
+from collections.abc import Iterable
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from vllm.config import VllmConfig
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.logits_processor import LogitsProcessor
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.mamba.mamba_utils import MambaStateCopyFunc
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.sensenova_loop_mhc import MHCRouter
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.vocab_parallel_embedding import (
+    ParallelLMHead,
+    VocabParallelEmbedding,
+)
+from vllm.sequence import IntermediateTensors
+
+from .interfaces import HasInnerState, IsHybrid, SupportsMRoPE
+from .qwen3_5 import (
+    Qwen3_5DecoderLayer,
+    Qwen3_5ForCausalLMBase,
+    Qwen3_5Model,
+    Qwen3_5RMSNorm,
+)
+from .utils import AutoWeightsLoader, maybe_prefix
+
+
+class SenseNovaLoopDecoderLayer(Qwen3_5DecoderLayer):
+    def __init__(self, vllm_config: VllmConfig, layer_type: str, prefix: str) -> None:
+        super().__init__(vllm_config, layer_type, prefix)
+        config = vllm_config.model_config.hf_text_config
+        self.physical_index = config.loop_physical_indices[self.layer_idx]
+        self.mhc = config.mhc
+        self.mhc_active = self.mhc is not None and (
+            self.mhc["start"] <= self.physical_index < self.mhc["end"]
+        )
+        if self.mhc_active:
+            self.mhc_attn = MHCRouter(config.hidden_size, self.mhc)
+            self.mhc_ffn = MHCRouter(config.hidden_size, self.mhc)
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        residual: torch.Tensor | None,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        **kwargs: object,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor | None]:
+        if not self.mhc_active:
+            return super().forward(hidden_states, residual, positions, **kwargs)
+        if residual is not None:
+            hidden_states = hidden_states + residual
+        streams = self.mhc["streams"]
+        if self.physical_index == self.mhc["start"]:
+            hidden_states = hidden_states.unsqueeze(-2).expand(-1, streams, -1)
+        else:
+            hidden_states = hidden_states.unflatten(-1, (streams, -1))
+        branch, post, mix = self.mhc_attn(hidden_states)
+        branch = self.input_layernorm(branch.contiguous())
+        if self.layer_type == "linear_attention":
+            branch = self.linear_attn(hidden_states=branch)
+        else:
+            branch = self.self_attn(hidden_states=branch, positions=positions)
+        hidden_states = MHCRouter.merge(hidden_states, branch, post, mix)
+        branch, post, mix = self.mhc_ffn(hidden_states)
+        branch = self.mlp(self.post_attention_layernorm(branch.contiguous()))
+        hidden_states = MHCRouter.merge(hidden_states, branch, post, mix)
+        if self.physical_index == self.mhc["end"] - 1:
+            hidden_states = hidden_states.mean(-2)
+        else:
+            hidden_states = hidden_states.flatten(-2)
+        return hidden_states, None
+
+
+class SenseNovaLoopModel(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, *, vllm_config: VllmConfig, prefix: str = "") -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.config = vllm_config.model_config.hf_text_config
+        self.quant_config = None
+        self.vocab_size = self.config.vocab_size
+        self.embed_tokens = VocabParallelEmbedding(
+            self.vocab_size,
+            self.config.hidden_size,
+            prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "embed_tokens"),
+        )
+        self.layers = nn.ModuleList(
+            SenseNovaLoopDecoderLayer(vllm_config, layer_type, f"{prefix}.layers.{i}")
+            for i, layer_type in enumerate(self.config.layer_types)
+        )
+        self.norm = Qwen3_5RMSNorm(
+            self.config.hidden_size, eps=self.config.rms_norm_eps
+        )
+
+    def embed_input_ids(self, input_ids: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self.embed_tokens(input_ids)
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        input_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        intermediate_tensors: IntermediateTensors | None = None,
+        inputs_embeds: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        hidden_states = (
+            self.embed_input_ids(input_ids) if inputs_embeds is None else inputs_embeds
+        )
+        residual = None
+        for layer in self.layers:
+            hidden_states, residual = layer(hidden_states, residual, positions)
+        if residual is None:
+            return self.norm(hidden_states)
+        return self.norm(hidden_states, residual)[0]
+
+    def share_loop_parameters(self) -> None:
+        first: dict[int, nn.Module] = {}
+        for physical, layer in zip(self.config.loop_physical_indices, self.layers):
+            if physical not in first:
+                first[physical] = layer
+                continue
+            for name, param in first[physical].named_parameters():
+                parent, _, leaf = name.rpartition(".")
+                setattr(layer.get_submodule(parent), leaf, param)
+
+    def load_weights(self, weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]) -> set[str]:
+        return AutoWeightsLoader(self).load_weights(
+            weights, mapper=Qwen3_5Model.hf_to_vllm_mapper
+        )
+
+
+class SenseNovaLoopForConditionalGeneration(
+    nn.Module, HasInnerState, IsHybrid, SupportsMRoPE
+):
+    @classmethod
+    def get_mamba_state_dtype_from_config(
+        cls, vllm_config: VllmConfig
+    ) -> tuple[torch.dtype, torch.dtype]:
+        return Qwen3_5ForCausalLMBase.get_mamba_state_dtype_from_config(vllm_config)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def get_mamba_state_shape_from_config(
+        cls, vllm_config: VllmConfig
+    ) -> tuple[tuple[int, int], tuple[int, int]]:
+        return Qwen3_5ForCausalLMBase.get_mamba_state_shape_from_config(vllm_config)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def get_mamba_state_copy_func(
+        cls,
+    ) -> tuple[MambaStateCopyFunc, MambaStateCopyFunc]:
+        return Qwen3_5ForCausalLMBase.get_mamba_state_copy_func()
+
+    get_mrope_input_positions = Qwen3_5ForCausalLMBase.get_mrope_input_positions
+
+    def __init__(self, *, vllm_config: VllmConfig, prefix: str = "") -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.vllm_config = vllm_config
+        self.model_config = vllm_config.model_config
+        self.config = self.model_config.hf_text_config
+        if (
+            vllm_config.parallel_config.pipeline_parallel_size != 1
+            or vllm_config.quant_config is not None
+            or vllm_config.speculative_config is not None
+            or vllm_config.lora_config is not None
+            or getattr(self.config, "layer_scale", False)
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "SenseNova Loop currently requires unquantized text inference "
+                "without pipeline parallelism, LoRA, speculation or layer_scale"
+            )
+        self.quant_config = None
+        self.scheduler_config = vllm_config.scheduler_config
+        self.model = SenseNovaLoopModel(
+            vllm_config=vllm_config, prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "model")
+        )
+        self.lm_head = ParallelLMHead(
+            self.config.vocab_size,
+            self.config.hidden_size,
+            prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "lm_head"),
+        )
+        if self.config.tie_word_embeddings:
+            self.lm_head = self.lm_head.tie_weights(self.model.embed_tokens)
+        self.logits_processor = LogitsProcessor(self.config.vocab_size)
+
+    def embed_input_ids(self, input_ids: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self.model.embed_input_ids(input_ids)
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        input_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        intermediate_tensors: IntermediateTensors | None = None,
+        inputs_embeds: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        **kwargs: object,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self.model(input_ids, positions, intermediate_tensors, inputs_embeds)
+
+    def compute_logits(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor | None:
+        return self.logits_processor(self.lm_head, hidden_states)
+
+    def load_weights(self, weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]) -> set[str]:
+        destinations: dict[int, list[int]] = {}
+        for execution, physical in enumerate(self.config.loop_physical_indices):
+            destinations.setdefault(physical, []).append(execution)
+
+        def expanded_weights() -> Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]:
+            for name, weight in weights:
+                name = name.replace("model.language_model.", "model.", 1)
+                if name == "model.loop_gate.logits":
+                    continue
+                if name.startswith(("model.visual.", "visual.", "mtp.")):
+                    continue
+                if name.startswith("model.layers."):
+                    _, _, index, suffix = name.split(".", 3)
+                    for execution in destinations[int(index)]:
+                        yield f"model.layers.{execution}.{suffix}", weight
+                else:
+                    yield name, weight
+
+        return AutoWeightsLoader(self).load_weights(expanded_weights())
+
+    def process_weights_after_loading(self) -> None:
+        # Parameters share storage; attention modules and their caches stay distinct.
+        self.model.share_loop_parameters()

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+
+import math
+from typing import Any
+
+from transformers import PreTrainedConfig, Qwen3_5Config
+
+
+class SenseNovaLoopConfig(Qwen3_5Config):
+    model_type = "sensenova_loop"
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        loop_settings: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
+        mhc: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
+        loop_physical_num_layers: int | None = None,
+        loop_physical_layer_types: list[str] | None = None,
+        **kwargs,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__(**kwargs)
+        self.loop_settings = loop_settings
+        self.mhc = mhc
+        self.loop_physical_num_layers = (
+            loop_physical_num_layers or self.text_config.num_hidden_layers
+        )
+        self.loop_physical_layer_types = list(
+            loop_physical_layer_types or self.text_config.layer_types
+        )
+        self.get_text_config()
+
+    def get_text_config(self, **kwargs) -> PreTrainedConfig:
+        text = super().get_text_config(**kwargs)
+        # vLLM applies HF overrides after constructing this config.
+        if not hasattr(self, "loop_physical_num_layers") or text is self:
+            return text
+        mhc = self.mhc
+        num_layers = self.loop_physical_num_layers
+        loop_settings = self.loop_settings
+        if loop_settings is None:
+            loop_settings = {"start": 0, "end": num_layers, "eval_count": 1}
+        start, end, count = (loop_settings[k] for k in ("start", "end", "eval_count"))
+        if (
+            any(type(v) is not int for v in (start, end, count))
+            or not 0 <= start < end <= num_layers
+            or count < 1
+            or loop_settings.get("use_gate", False)
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Loop requires valid fixed bounds/count and use_gate=false"
+            )
+        indices = list(range(start)) + list(range(start, end)) * count
+        indices += list(range(end, num_layers))
+        layer_types = self.loop_physical_layer_types
+        if len(layer_types) != num_layers:
+            raise ValueError("layer_types must describe the physical layers")
+        if mhc is not None:
+            pre_scale = mhc.get("pre_scale", 1.0)
+            if (
+                not isinstance(pre_scale, (int, float))
+                or not math.isfinite(pre_scale)
+                or pre_scale <= 0
+            ):
+                raise ValueError(
+                    "Invalid mHC pre_scale: expected a positive finite number"
+                )
+            mhc_start, mhc_end, streams, iterations = (
+                mhc[k] for k in ("start", "end", "streams", "iterations")
+            )
+            bounds = (0, start, end, num_layers)
+            if (
+                any(
+                    type(v) is not int
+                    for v in (mhc_start, mhc_end, streams, iterations)
+                )
+                or streams not in (2, 4)
+                or iterations < 1
+                or type(mhc["fixed_identity"]) is not bool
+                or not any(
+                    left <= mhc_start < mhc_end <= right
+                    for left, right in zip(bounds, bounds[1:])
+                )
+            ):
+                raise ValueError(
+                    "Invalid mHC settings or range crossing a loop boundary"
+                )
+        text.loop_physical_indices = indices
+        text.mhc = mhc
+        text.num_hidden_layers = len(indices)
+        text.layer_types = [layer_types[i] for i in indices]
+        return text
